details.description: Code Llama - Instruct 34B is Meta's instruction-tuned version of the 34B Code Llama base model, fine-tuned with additional data to follow natural-language instructions for code generation, explanation, and question answering. Meta released it August 24, 2023 alongside the base and Python-specialized 34B checkpoints, and its Hugging Face model card positions it as the safer of the three for code-assistant and chat-style deployments.
advantages: Scores 57.0% pass@1 on MBPP, higher than the base 34B model's 55.0% (Code Llama paper, Table 2).
Fine-tuned with additional instruction data so it can follow natural-language coding prompts, and Meta's Hugging Face model card describes it as safer to deploy than the base model.
disadvantages: Scores 41.5% pass@1 on HumanEval, lower than both the base 34B model (48.8%) and the Python-specialized 34B model (53.7%), per the Code Llama paper's own Table 2.
Unlike the 7B and 13B Code Llama sizes, the 34B and 70B models were not trained with fill-in-the-middle (infilling) capability (Meta Code Llama blog).
use_cases: Following natural-language instructions to write, explain, or debug code

sources.title: Code Llama: A state-of-the-art large language model for coding
Code Llama: Open Foundation Models for Code

notes: The paper's own Table 2 shows this Instruct variant scoring lower on HumanEval than both the base and Python 34B checkpoints, so that is stated as a real limitation rather than assumed. Catalog's 16384 max_input/max_output_tokens matches Fireworks' listed ~16.3k-token serving context.
